title: Breaking signature change inside Python circular import cycle
description: Verifies Python reverse BFS handles node_a.py <-> node_b.py cycle and captures pkg/runner.py.
diff:
diff --git a/pkg/node_a.py b/pkg/node_a.py
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/pkg/node_a.py
+++ b/pkg/node_a.py
@@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
 from .node_b import ping_b
 
 
-def ping_a(limit: int) -> str:
+def ping_a(limit: int, mode: str) -> str:
     if limit <= 0:
         return "a"
     return ping_b(limit - 1)
